clause.description: The briefing's clause on the kind when every unit counted is the plugin's, `{counter}` where its count goes. A string, or a table of its CLDR plural forms, `other` required.

empty.description: What the kind's queue says when it holds nothing.

queue.description: The title of the kind's queue, such as "Ready to merge".

decisions.description: The plugin's words of the decisions its units wait on, by decision kind, which replace the kind's own when every unit counted is the plugin's.

title.description: What the field means, as its tooltip shows it.

detail.description: How a field of the plugin's unit detail shows, by field.

label.description: The field's name on the card.

markdown.description: The field's value is Markdown, such as an inline comment's body: the card renders it as it renders the draft's text.

values.description: The words of the field's values, by value, such as an enum's; the card keeps the value itself in its tooltip.

fields.description: The payload's fields, by the key they have in the payload, at any depth.

drafts.description: The words of a draft's payload on its card, by the draft kind the manifest declares; a field with no word shows as its key, a value with none as itself.

data.description: How the event's data shows on a timeline.

label.description: The event in a few words. Required.

loop.description: The event is the loop's doing, which the activity's loop filter keeps; its tone is "loop" when it sets no other.

tone.description: The tone the timeline and the activity draw the event in.

events.description: How each event kind the plugin declares shows on a timeline, by kind.

buckets.description: How each age bucket of a time facet shows, by bucket id.

colors.description: For the facet that colors the strip: the hue of each value's strip and dot, by value; a value it does not name takes nobody's.

empty.description: What a row with no value shows.

label.description: The facet's name, as the filter menu and the groups show it. Required.

label_prefix.description: Text before the label of each value the facet shows on a row, such as `by ` before an author; a label that has it already keeps it.

row_class.description: The class of a row that holds a value, by value, such as `{ me = "mine" }`, which the cockpit's stylesheet colors.

show.description: The part of a row the facet's values show in, each a button that filters by its value: a part's name, or a table of one part to the values it shows there, such as `{ flag = ["paused", "muted"] }`, or `""` to take a facet a lower layer places off the row. Absent or `""`, the facet is only for filters, groups and sorts. A value `none` and a time facet's item without a time never show.

age.description: The values the facet shows in the age part.

aside.description: The values the facet shows in the aside part.

flag.description: The values the facet shows in the flag part.

kind.description: The values the facet shows in the kind part.

meta.description: The values the facet shows in the meta part.

ref.description: The values the facet shows in the ref part.

who.description: The values the facet shows in the who part.

show_label.description: For a facet shown in the age part: the label of its date, a template over `{{.age}}`, the age in the row words, and `{{.at}}`, the time, which each client writes in its own locale, such as `since {{.at}}`. Absent, the age alone.

show_max.description: How many of an item's values the part shows at most; the rest count into one piece in the `more` row word. Absent or 0, all.

show_values.description: How many of an item's values the part shows: all, or the first alone.

additionalProperties.description: The values one facet must hold.

show_when.description: Shows the facet only on a row that holds, in each facet it names, one of the listed values, such as `{ turn = ["me"] }`; each named facet must be declared. Two age facets with opposite show_when place the row's one date by whom it waits on.

values.description: How each value shows, by value; a value it does not name shows as itself.

facets.description: The words of the plugin's facets, by facet id.

lens.description: The plugin's own words of its rows, replacing the row words of views.toml's [lens] by the same keys.

age_days.description: A row's age from a day, over its days `{{.d}}` and the hours past them `{{.h}}`.

age_hours.description: A row's age under a day, over its hours `{{.h}}` and the minutes past them `{{.m}}`.

age_minutes.description: A row's age under an hour, over its minutes as `{{.m}}`.

age_now.description: A row's age under a minute.

briefing.description: The flag of a row whose intake waits for its brief.

briefing_attempt.description: What the briefing flag's tooltip adds of a retried intake, over the attempt `{{.n}}`.

briefing_error.description: What the briefing flag's tooltip adds of an intake's last error, over the `{{.error}}`.

briefing_title.description: The briefing flag's tooltip, over the intake's `{{.seq}}`.

changed.description: The flag of a task that changed since you last opened it.

col_actions.description: The head of the list column of a row's actions.

col_age.description: The head of the list column of a row's age.

col_aside.description: The head of the list column of a row's workspace and links.

col_unit.description: What a row view whose rows mix kinds calls its unit, as `list_count`'s `{{.unit}}`.

col_who.description: The head of the list column of whom a row waits on.

col_why.description: The head of the list column of why a row waits.

countdown_minutes.description: A pending round's countdown from 100 seconds, over its minutes `{{.m}}` and the seconds past them, two digits, `{{.s}}`.

countdown_seconds.description: A pending round's countdown under 100 seconds, over the seconds `{{.s}}`.

countdown_sending.description: A pending round's countdown once its deadline passed.

countdown_title.description: The tooltip of a pending round's countdown, over the `{{.time}}` it sends at.

due.description: The flag of a task's deadline, over the `{{.date}}`.

every.description: How often a project is reviewed, over the `{{.every}}`.

filter_group.description: What a facet button calls whom a row waits on when the value is a group of people, such as a Slack user group, in place of the facet's label.

filter_label.description: What a facet button on a row says to a screen reader, over the facet's `{{.label}}` and the `{{.value}}`.

filter_title.description: A facet button's tooltip, over the facet's `{{.label}}` and the `{{.value}}`.

filter_title_group.description: A facet button's tooltip when its facet groups, over `{{.label}}`, `{{.value}}` and the `{{.group}}` field's label.

legend_title.description: The tooltip of the legend of a view's strip, the colors of its strip facet's values.

list_count.description: A row view's summary, over its `{{.unit}}`, how many rows the filter `{{.shown}}` and how many the view holds, `{{.total}}`.

list_empty.description: What a plugin view's list says when it holds no row and the plugin gives no words of its own.

more.description: The piece that counts the values a facet's `show_max` leaves off a row, over their number `{{.n}}`.

no_next_action.description: The flag of a project with no open child.

open_children.description: A project's open children, over their number `{{.n}}`.

questions.description: The pill of a brief's open questions, over their number `{{.n}}`.

review_due.description: The flag of a project past its review.

reviewed.description: When a project was last reviewed, over the `{{.date}}`.

sequential.description: The flag of a project that takes its children one at a time.

sort_by.description: The tooltip of the list toolbar's Sort chip, over the `{{.label}}` of the facet it sorts by.

stale.description: The flag of a row whose plugin is not reporting.

starred.description: The tooltip of a starred task's star.

tip_kind.description: A row's tooltip with its situation, over the `{{.tip}}` so far and the `{{.kind}}` labels.

tip_named.description: A row's tooltip's start when it names whom the row waits on, over the `{{.strip}}` value's label and `{{.who}}`.

tip_why.description: A row's tooltip with why it waits, over the `{{.tip}}` so far and the `{{.why}}`.

unread.description: The flag of a task whose links hold messages the extraction has not read, over how long the oldest waited, `{{.lag}}`.

until.description: The flag of a task asleep until a date, over the `{{.date}}`.

menubar.description: The heading of each menu bar section, by section id.

noun.description: What one of the plugin's units is, which the briefing counts, such as "pull request". A string, or a table of its CLDR plural forms, `other` required.

additionalProperties.description: One reason's words, `{{.name}}` where a value the situation gives goes, such as `changes requested by {{.actor}}`.

reasons.description: Why a unit waits, as its row says it, by the reason key its situation names; a reason with no words shows as the plugin wrote it.

label.description: The signal's name, before its value. Required.

additionalProperties.description: One note's words, `{{.name}}` where a value the note gives goes and `{{plural .name "one" "…" "other" "…"}}` its plural form, such as `stalled for {{.days}} {{plural .days "one" "working day" "other" "working days"}}`.

notes.description: How each note shows after the signal's value, in the note's own tone, by code.

additionalProperties.description: One value's words, `{{.name}}` where a value the signal gives goes, such as `failing: {{.names}}`.

values.description: How each value shows, by code.

values_from.description: Where the signal's values take their words from besides its own values.

signals.description: How each line of the plugin's cards shows, by the signal's key: the plugin sends the key, a value code, the values its words fill and the codes of its notes; a code with no words shows as itself.

situations.description: How each situation the plugin derives shows, by kind, in a few words.

default_sort.description: What the sort menu calls a row view's own order, such as "Waiting longest".

label.description: The view's name, as navigation lists it. Required.

search.description: A custom view's search: the queries it runs at a press, the terms it toggles and the orders it offers.

decisions.description: How a result's decision reads, by value.

default_sort.description: The order a query with none is read in.

filters.description: A term the query toggles, or a window of recent activity.

term.description: The term toggled in the query.

window.description: Days of recent activity the filter keeps, in place of a term.

no_decision.description: What a result with no decision reads.

presets.description: A query run at a press.

query.description: The query, in the source's search syntax. Required.

label.description: Its words on its button. Required.

shown.description: How a result names the order, such as "waiting longest".

sort.description: The order's value in the query. Required.

unit.description: What one of the view's rows is, such as "Pull request", the unit column's heading; empty for a view whose rows mix kinds.

views.description: The words of the plugin's views, by view id.

title: A plugin's views, facets and situations (ui.toml)
